title: KV shares a stunning single titled “LUV HANDLES”
htmlContent:
KV is an American singer and songwriter currently making waves in the music industry, especially with the release of her single “LUV HANDLES.” Everything about this record screams appeal, with a stand-out sound digestible in every way to make something for people to enjoy.

KV’s “LUV HANDLES” is a record that shines musically and makes you want to look out for this rising star. It shines in the audio in every natural way, with it all being done at a high level to ensure that people can enjoy a record with no limits.
